purpose: Mode-specific UI improvements to reduce clutter and enforce clearer workflows.

recommendations: Use a left navigation rail or tabs within Author Mode so the timeline does not dominate every task.
Treat source/draft/canon comparison as one workspace, not the whole Author UI.
Add card summaries for world areas with counts, review status, and unresolved decisions.
Separate narrative design from data validation to reduce cognitive load.
Hide raw draft data completely by default.
Show one primary scene/current node at a time rather than a full timeline.
Move validation and patch tools out of Player Mode.
Keep Dev Mode technical and avoid duplicating Author source review.
Add validator cards for each data type.
Show feature flags and their consequences clearly.
Keep AI provider configuration isolated from Player/Author UX.
